notes: Credit, and a start and finish read from the map's own logic. The 60 spawns stand in a holding room at about (16, -11150, -600) whose floor teleports to the cpb destination; the start is a box round cpb, where the player lands. The finish is the trigger in the end room (cp_end destination, far below the course) that shows the map's closing text. Checkpoints are class-renaming triggers with class-filtered teleports; the importer drops those whose class no player passes, leaving the unfiltered per-level pits.

zones.note: the first island, round the cpb destination the spawn room's floor teleport sends to (the text trigger 'By Nate' is beside it); the spawn room itself is only a holding room
the end room trigger that shows the closing text, beside the cp_end destination
